project_name: Permian Basin 765 kV import paths (Dinosaur-Longshore; Bell East-Big Hill-Sand Lake; Howard-Solstice)
sponsor: Oncor / LCRA TSC / AEP Texas / CPS
instrument: PUCT order approving the three 765 kV import paths (PBRP Table 7.5), Project No. 55718, 2025-04-24; CCN route dockets 59315/59029/59475/59182/59366 pending 2026-07
mapping_note: The PBRP publishes ONE combined figure — 2,105 MW incremental N-1 import capability into the Permian for the three-path 765 plan (Study Table E.1/7.6) — not per-path ratings. The model's West links are symmetric TTCs whose 7,300/2,700 statics are the measured WESTEX EXPORT GTC medians; applying an import-direction increment to the same symmetric envelope would double-count with the STEP export re-rate rows below, so this row records the import increment at 0.0 (documentation) and the import-side representation (a one-way pair split like NE_LOB) is a named topology follow-up (methodology sec 6).
source_doc: ERCOT Permian Basin Reliability Plan Study July 2024 Tables E.1/7.5/7.6; PUCT 2025-04-24 order
notes: Path CODs: Dinosaur-Longshore 2028; Bell East-Big Hill-Sand Lake and Howard-Solstice 2030. Schedule risk: PUCT abated Docket 59029 June 2026; 43 legislators filed amicus urging deferral; no 765 route order issued as of 2026-07-19.

project_name: Texas 765 kV STEP Core Plan (import paths + Western Loop + Eastern Backbone) - WTX export re-rate
instrument: ERCOT Board endorsement of Tier 1 RPG projects 25RPG022 (Western Loop, 2025-12-09) and 25RPG025 (Eastern Backbone $9.38B, 2025-12-09) on top of the PUCT 765 import-path order; CCNs still to be filed
mapping_note: ERCOT's Independent Review (Nov 2025 sec 2.1-2.2) states the full 765 STEP Core Plan raises the West Texas Export stability GTC 12.7 -> 16.2 GW (+3,500 MW). The model's WESTEX statics are the measured 2023-24 limit-at-bind medians (10,000 MW summed) split 8:3 across West-North (7,300) and West-South_Central (2,700); per rule 14 the published DELTA (+3,500) is applied to the measured base using the same in-repo 8:3 split convention: +2,555 here, +945 on the companion row. Base mismatch documented: ERCOT's 12.7 GW is the 2025 rating basis, our 10,000 is the measured-median basis — the delta, not the level, transfers.
source_doc: ERCOT board item 25RPG025 Dec 2025; ERCOT Independent Review Nov 2025 sec 2.1-2.2
notes: Phased 2030-2032; the export re-rate requires the FULL Core Plan so in_service_year 2032 is the conservative full-plan year.

project_name: Texas 765 kV STEP Core Plan - WTX export re-rate (South_Central leg)
instrument: ERCOT Board endorsement of 25RPG022 + 25RPG025 (2025-12-09) on top of the PUCT 765 import-path order
mapping_note: Companion to step-backbone--west_north: the +3,500 MW WTX-export-GTC increment split 8:3 per the repo's WESTEX convention — +945 MW on the West-South_Central leg (static 2,700). Same measured-base-vs-rating-base caveat.
source_doc: ERCOT board item 25RPG025 Dec 2025; ERCOT Independent Review Nov 2025 sec 2.1-2.2

project_name: 765 kV STEP Eastern Backbone - Watermill-Martin Lake segment
mapping_note: 152-mi 765 kV Watermill (Dallas Co, North) -> Martin Lake (Rusk Co, Northeast), segment rating >= 7,603 MVA — a step change against the NE_LOB one-way pair (export 1,300 / import 1,788 MW measured statics). No published NE_LOB re-rate — recorded 0.0 (rule 5); expect the GTC to be retired/re-rated post-COD. The backbone also creates Martin Lake -> Hillje (Northeast -> Houston), a path the 7-zone topology lacks (topology follow-up, methodology sec 6).
notes: Row targets the (North, Northeast) one-way import leg orientation; both legs are affected.

project_name: 765 kV STEP Eastern Backbone - Hillje-Blu Lacy segment

source_doc: ERCOT board item 25RPG025 Dec 2025; Independent Review Nov 2025

project_name: Permian Basin Reliability Plan local 138/345 kV upgrades (bundle)
instrument: PUCT order adopting the PBRP (Project No. 55718), 2024-09-26 (written order Oct 2024)
mapping_note: ~$4.0B of 138/345 kV rebuilds, second circuits and new stations entirely inside the West zone (Permian). Raises local deliverability, no modeled inter-zone limit changes. Dispatch-inert by schema; staged CODs 2025-2030 (2028 recorded as the bundle midpoint, labeled).
source_doc: ERCOT PBRP Study July 2024 Tables E.2/E.3

project_name: Lower Rio Grande Valley 345 kV system enhancement
instrument: ERCOT Board endorsement with critical-to-reliability designation (Dec 2021); PUCT CCN final orders per segment 2023-2024 (Dockets 55151, 55397, Cenizo-Cruce order 2024-05-30)
mapping_note: ~351 circuit-miles of new double-circuit 345 kV Laredo -> Valley (Cenizo-Cruce-Del Sol/Reforzar-Frontera), ~$1.28B. Materially raises deliverability into the Valley lobe INSIDE the South zone — the VALEXP GTC pocket the 7-zone topology cannot represent (iso_configs caveat). No published import-limit MW. Dispatch-inert by schema.
source_doc: AEP Texas RGV project pages; PUCT dockets 55151/55397
notes: Staged CODs through 2026 (Del Sol-Frontera summer 2026; some slippage into 2027 plausible).
